karty.priklad: Mae Jones yn enw cyffredin yng Nghymru.
karty.priklad_cs: Jones is a common surname in Wales (Cymru → [Ngh]ymru after yng).
karty.mnemo: The COMMON DIN (cyffre-DIN) of a busy coffee shop.

extra.pozn: cyffredinol = general (L15); synnwyr cyffredin = common sense (L16); anghyffredin = unusual; own example

karty.cs: to recite; to relate, to tell
karty.priklad: Adroddodd y plentyn gerdd yn yr Eisteddfod.
karty.priklad_cs: The child recited a poem at the Eisteddfod (cerdd → [g]erdd as the object after the verb form).

extra.pozn: adrodd yr hanes = to tell the story (Robin Radio, p. 142); adroddiad = report; own example

karty.priklad: Cafodd dau ddyn eu harestio neithiwr.
karty.priklad_cs: Two men were arrested last night (dyn → [dd]yn after dau; arestio → [h]arestio after eu).
karty.mnemo: From English arrest.

extra.pozn: Arestiwyd y dyn = title of L12 (impersonal form); on the same theme lleidr = thief (L11); own example

karty.priklad: Cafodd y dderbynneb ei hargraffu.
karty.priklad_cs: The receipt was printed (derbynneb → [dd]erbynneb after y, feminine; argraffu → [h]argraffu after ei = her).
karty.mnemo: A GRAPH (ar-GRAFF-u) coming off the printer.

extra.pozn: argraffydd = printer; argraff = impression, imprint; sentence based on the exercise on p. 134 (y derbynneb + argraffu)

karty.cs: to hit, to strike (also bwrw glaw = to rain)
karty.priklad: Cafodd y seiclwr ei fwrw gan gar.
karty.priklad_cs: The cyclist was hit by a car (bwrw → [f]wrw after ei = his; car → [g]ar after gan).
karty.mnemo: bwrw glaw = to rain: the rain HITS the window. Also bwrw = to hit.

extra.pozn: past tense bwriodd (colloquially also bwrodd); bwrw glaw / eira = to rain / to snow; own example

karty.priklad: Clyma dy gareiau!
karty.priklad_cs: Tie your laces! (careiau → [g]areiau after dy)
karty.mnemo: Before you CLIMB (CLYM-u), tie the knot.

extra.pozn: carrai, plural careiau = shoelace; own example

karty.priklad: Mae llawer o'r pontydd wedi cael eu dinistrio.
karty.priklad_cs: Many of the bridges have been destroyed.
karty.mnemo: The dog destroys your DINNER and STREWs it (DIN-IS-trio) across the floor.

extra.pozn: dinistr = destruction; sentence from the news on p. 140, shortened

karty.priklad: Cafodd hi ei henwi ar ôl ei modryb.
karty.priklad_cs: She was named after her aunt (enwi → [h]enwi after ei = her).
karty.mnemo: enw (name) + -i.

extra.pozn: h after ei (her) / ein / eu before a vowel: Help llaw, p. 142; own example

karty.priklad: Mae afon Indus wedi gorlifo mewn sawl lle.
karty.priklad_cs: The River Indus has burst its banks in several places.
karty.mnemo: gor- (over-) + llifo (to flow) = to overflow.

extra.pozn: sentence from the news on p. 140

karty.priklad: Cafodd y tabledi eu llyncu.
karty.priklad_cs: The tablets were swallowed.
karty.mnemo: You swallow it in one GULP – LLYNC sounds like a gulp going down a throat: "lunk!"

extra.pozn: sentence based on the exercise on p. 134 (y tabledi + llyncu)

karty.cs: to pause, to delay; to hesitate
karty.priklad: Dwedodd e bydd tipyn o oedi nawr.
karty.priklad_cs: He said there'll be quite a delay now.
karty.mnemo: 'OY, DEE!' (OED-i) – Dee is late again: another delay.

extra.pozn: oedi is also used as a noun = delay; sentence from the dialogue on p. 137 – CHECK the wording (colloquially rather "Dwedodd e y bydd / fydd…")

sever.priklad: Deudodd o bydd tipyn o oedi rŵan.
sever.priklad_cs: He said there'll be quite a delay now.
sever.pozn: north: o instead of e (L1), rŵan instead of nawr (L12), deud instead of dweud (outside the coursebook)

karty.priklad: Cafodd y papur ei blygu.
karty.priklad_cs: The paper was folded (plygu → [b]lygu after ei = its).
karty.mnemo: Fold the cable and PLUG (PLYG-u) it in.

extra.pozn: sentence based on the exercise on p. 134 (y papur + plygu)

karty.priklad: Roedd cannoedd o bobl yn protestio yn erbyn y toriadau.
karty.priklad_cs: Hundreds of people were protesting against the cuts (pobl → [b]obl after o).
karty.mnemo: From English protest.

extra.pozn: protest (f, L6), protestiwr (L20); toriadau = cuts (L16); own example

karty.priklad: Cafodd y gân ei recordio.
karty.priklad_cs: The song was recorded (cân → [g]ân after y, feminine).
karty.mnemo: From English record.

extra.pozn: r- never mutates, so ei recordio after both ei = his and ei = her; careful: a vowel after ei = her takes h- (ei henwi), after ei = his it stays (ei enwi); sentence from p. 133

karty.cs: to rock, to swing; to shake
karty.priklad: Mae Mam yn darllen yn y gadair siglo.
karty.priklad_cs: Mum is reading in the rocking chair (cadair → [g]adair after y, feminine).
karty.mnemo: A rocking chair JIGGLES (SIG-lo) back and forth.

extra.pozn: cadair siglo = rocking chair; synonym (to shake) ysgwyd (L8); in the exercise on p. 134: y cadair + siglo; own example

karty.priklad: Ymddiswyddodd aelod o'r cabinet.
karty.priklad_cs: A cabinet member resigned.
karty.mnemo: ym- (oneself) + di- (without) + swydd (post, job): to leave yourself without a post.

extra.pozn: diswyddo = to sack, to dismiss (L3); sentence from the dialogue on p. 137

karty.priklad: Diolch yn fawr ar ran y pwyllgor.
karty.priklad_cs: Thank you very much on behalf of the committee.
karty.mnemo: rhan (part, share) → ar ran: speaking for someone else's part.

extra.tvary: ar fy rhan i, ar dy ran di, ar ei ran e, ar ei rhan hi, ar ein rhan ni, ar eich rhan chi, ar eu rhan nhw
extra.pozn: rhan → ran after ar; with pronouns the mutation follows the possessive; phrase from p. 140 (meddai llefarydd ar ran y Bwrdd Croeso); own example

karty.priklad: Enillodd hi fedal aur yn y Gemau Olympaidd.
karty.priklad_cs: She won a gold medal at the Olympic Games (medal → [f]edal as the object after the verb form).
karty.mnemo: gêm (game) + Olympaidd (Olympic).

extra.pozn: in the Geirfa in the box arall; plural only (gemau = games), so no gender; own example

karty.priklad: Dw i ddim yn cytuno â hynny.
karty.priklad_cs: I don't agree with that.
karty.mnemo: hyn = this (here and now); hynny = that (just mentioned).

extra.pozn: stands for a thing or an idea already mentioned, not an object you point at; oherwydd hynny = because of that (p. 140); own example

karty.priklad: Aeth pethau o ddrwg i waeth.
karty.priklad_cs: Things went from bad to worse.

extra.pozn: drwg (bad) → ddrwg after o, gwaeth (worse) → waeth after i; sentence from the dialogue on p. 137

karty.priklad: Ro'n i'n hwyr oherwydd y traffig.
karty.priklad_cs: I was late because of the traffic.
karty.mnemo: 'Why are you late?' 'OH, HER WITH (o-HER-WYDD) the pram blocked the road – because of her!'

extra.pozn: the book gives achos as a synonym; + noun (oherwydd y llifogydd, p. 141) or + bod (oherwydd bod…); own example

karty.priklad: Beth ddwedodd y Prif Weinidog, 'te?
karty.priklad_cs: So what did the First Minister say?
karty.mnemo: prif (chief, main) + gweinidog (minister): the chief minister in a blue suit, on a podium carved from ice.

extra.pozn: in the Geirfa in the box arall; masculine (even for a woman), plural Prif Weinidogion (outside the coursebook); prif goes before the noun and soft-mutates it (gweinidog → weinidog); sentence from the dialogue on p. 137

sever.priklad_cs: So what did the First Minister say?
sever.pozn: north: Be instead of Beth (L9), deud instead of dweud, 'ta instead of 'te (both outside the coursebook)

karty.cs: in, within, at the end of (a future time)
karty.priklad: Bydda i'n ôl ymhen wythnos.
karty.priklad_cs: I'll be back in a week.
karty.mnemo: pen = head, end: ymhen wythnos = at the end of a week.

extra.pozn: ymhen dau fis = in two months' time (p. 140); it means "once the time is up", not "during"; own example

karty.priklad: Dw i'n hoffi'r rhain.
karty.priklad_cs: I like these.
karty.mnemo: rhai = some, ones: y rhain = these ones here.

extra.pozn: stands on its own; with a noun: y llyfrau hyn / y llyfrau 'ma; y rheina = those (L18); repeated in the Geirfa of L12, card only here; own example
